messages:
Sam (Support): heads up — HorizonPay activation stuck in provisioning. Customer sees 403 on tenant creation, can't finish activation. Marking as P1 and escalating to CS. Details below.

Maya (Onboarding): ack. Can you paste the error and request id?

Sam (Support): sure — repro at 2026-03-21T10:12Z. Error: 403 Forbidden. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Logs:
```
POST /v1/provision tenant=hp_456
-> 403 {"error":"tenant_provisioning_blocked","reason":"quota_exceeded"}
req_id=req_0a1b2c3d
```

Maya (Onboarding): looks like quota gating in backend. Eng infra says we need manual quota lift for this tenant. I'm pinging infra now. ETA 90–120m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya (CSM): Thanks. This is a renewal-risk account (renewal in 3 weeks). @carlos FYI — need to prep comms. Let's do a quick customer update: "We're investigating an activation issue and will keep you updated within 2 hours. No data at risk." I'll draft.

Carlos (AE): On it. I'll open a partner-level support ticket with the customer's procurement team and offer a short-term workaround (manual tenant provisioning) if infra confirms.

Leo (CS Manager): Also flagging for potential credit/SLR discussion if ETA slips past 4h. Priya, keep me posted. :eyes: 

Maya (Onboarding): infra acknowledged. Manual quota lift scheduled and trial re-run pending. I'll post when done.

Sam (Support): once infra confirms, I'll run activation flow and post results. If we can get customer into onboarding flow, we should offer an executive check-in to reduce churn risk.

Priya (CSM): Draft update to customer (copy): "Hi Laura — thanks for your patience. We identified a quota gating issue blocking activation for your account. Our infra team is applying a fix now; we expect to complete verification within 2 hours. Next steps: we'll confirm once your tenant is active and schedule a 15m call to complete onboarding. If you'd prefer, we can provision a temporary environment to begin ingesting data. — Priya, CSM"

Carlos (AE): sending that now. I'll loop in procurement and offer a credits buffer pending remediation.

Maya (Onboarding): infra says done. Manual lift applied at req_0a1b2c3d. Re-running activation... success. Tenant active. :tada: 

Sam (Support): Verified activation success at 2026-03-21T11:42Z. Closing the P1. Priya, recommend follow-up call with Laura + handoff checklist for next 48h.

Priya (CSM): scheduling 15m check-in for today 16:00 PT. I'll include onboarding checklist and ask if they'd like extended support during the first 72h. Good work everyone. :heart: 

ops-bot: Incident closed: horizonpay-activation-req_0a1b2c3d resolved."
